summary: FLUX 3 Klein image placed by a caption with layout boxes (BFL's balloons example).
description: FLUX 3 Image Klein text to image from a caption with layout boxes: the prose tags each element as <id>, and a JSON table gives every id a bbox as [top, left, bottom, right] on a 0 to 1000 grid plus a description. The caption here is BFL's own upsampled balloons example, used as written; upsampling boxes from a short request is not covered yet. Boxes are hints, not masks: a small boxed element may not appear, and elements can run past their box. The family rules for steps, guidance, size, placement and the license are in text-to-image.

width.reason: FLUX 3 Image Klein's pipeline refuses a width not divisible by 16 (the VAE's 8x compression times the 2x2 latent packing), and only after the weights have loaded, so it is checked here first
